summary: Sanders County ground lookout on Penrose Peak, set up as a ready-cut L-4 cab in 1930; listed as gone, with no source describing the site today.

facts.status_note: The lookout is gone. No source gives a removal date or describes the summit today.

events.note: Ready-cut house packed up in July 1930 and installed by late September 1930; the listing gives a 1930 L-4 cab
In August 1932 the lookout was sent to a fire, was hurt in a fall on the way, and replacements were sent out

notes_for_editor: Thin record: three pages, no removal date, no description of the summit today, and no photo. The listing gives the elevation as 7381 ft; the Wikipedia infobox gives 7,232 ft, which is not used. The 1932 lookout is named in the source; the story leaves the name out. The record's coordinates match the Forest Fire Lookout Association listing. Fact-check 2026-10-10: all quotes found; the story's negative claim about removal now cites both the listing and the newspaper items.
